children: Marvell Technology (MRVL, Financials) is receiving a renewed vote of confidence from Seaport Research Partners as demand for AI data-center infrastructure bolsters its custom silicon and interconnect businesses.

Seaport Initiates Coverage on Seaport With a Buy Rating and $270 Price Target Seaport said it sees major development prospects around AI data centers. Marvell's optical connection technologies are used in accelerator platforms including those from Nvidia, offering the company access to ongoing data center expansion.

The company is closely scrutinizing Marvell's margins. The company projected a current quarter non-GAAP gross margin of 58.25% to 59.25%, compared with 59.4% a year ago. Seaport expects operating leverage to come mostly from managing operating expenses rather than from any meaningful expansion of gross margins.
Seaport also started coverage on Semtech (SMTC, Financials) with a $200 target as its increasing focus on data-center optical devices should drive AI-related demand in 2027 and 2028.

On Semiconductor (ON, Financials) has a $100 objective based on growing industrial and automotive demand with an expected 800-volt data-center build-out. Seaport also liked ON's planned acquisition for Synaptics.
The next Marvell catalyst shows AI-led demand can morph into sustainable revenue growth as the business faces gross-margin pressure.

title: Marvell's AI Infrastructure Bet Gets a Fresh Wall Street Vote
